question: For each instance display name, report the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of system-metadata rows per completed migration for that instance (restricted to instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'), but only include those instance display names whose metadata-count range is greater than the overall average metadata-count range across all such 'prime' instances. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH per_migration AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_count
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
    AND m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY i.display_name, m.id
),
instance_stats AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         MAX(metadata_count) - MIN(metadata_count) AS range_val,
         VARIANCE(metadata_count) AS variance_val,
         STDDEV(metadata_count) AS stddev_val
  FROM per_migration
  GROUP BY display_name
),
avg_range AS (
  SELECT AVG(range_val) AS avg_range
  FROM instance_stats
)
SELECT s.display_name,
       s.range_val,
       s.variance_val,
       s.stddev_val
FROM instance_stats s
CROSS JOIN avg_range a
WHERE s.range_val > a.avg_range
ORDER BY s.display_name

WITH per_migration AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_count
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
    AND m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY i.display_name, m.id
),
instance_stats AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         MAX(metadata_count) - MIN(metadata_count) AS range_val,
         VARIANCE(metadata_count) AS variance_val,
         STDDEV(metadata_count) AS stddev_val
  FROM per_migration
  GROUP BY display_name
),
avg_range AS (
  SELECT AVG(range_val) AS avg_range
  FROM instance_stats
)
SELECT s.display_name,
       s.range_val,
       s.variance_val,
       s.stddev_val
FROM instance_stats s
CROSS JOIN avg_range a
WHERE s.range_val > a.avg_range
ORDER BY s.display_name

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH per_migration AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(s.id) AS meta_count
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m.status = 'completed'
  LEFT JOIN instance_system_metadata s ON s.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
  GROUP BY i.display_name, m.id
),
per_instance AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         MAX(meta_count) - MIN(meta_count) AS range_val,
         VARIANCE(meta_count) AS var_val,
         STDDEV(meta_count) AS std_val
  FROM per_migration
  GROUP BY display_name
)
SELECT display_name, range_val, var_val, std_val
FROM per_instance
WHERE range_val > (SELECT AVG(range_val) FROM per_instance)
ORDER BY display_name;
